contracts: Original typed resources are TypeId-keyed owned Box values. Named resources are an independent string-keyed Box index; named type mismatch reports MissingResource.
Native registration indexes borrow explicit User/associated Global owners. Typed/named indexes remain independent and replacement does not destroy arena-owned objects.
Current lookup and generated Checker reads must observe the latest registry entry. Nested payload observations are copied explicitly into Global before User deletion.

Native ResourceBorrow checks stable Global ContextState before touching a deleted User arena; get/copy of an expired borrow must fail. Old managed objects remain accessible until their owning arena closes.
Raw typed missing-resource names use Rust type paths versus native compiler type names; this is an existing documented language adaptation, not equal diagnostic text.
